# Overview

This package fits Bayesian generalized linear models using MCMC.

# Methodological details

Full details are available in the associated manuscript.  
The link will be added after publication.

# Example

```r
library(BGLM)

y <- floor(exp(rlnorm(100)))

fit <- UTME(y=y)

str(fit)
```
